name: Saimin Seitokai ~Saiminjutsu Tsukatte Gekokujou! Kouman Seito Kaichou mo Namaiki Yakuin mo Zen'in Ore no Niku Omocha!~
original_name: 催眠生徒会～催眠術使って下克上! 高慢生徒会長も生意気役員も全員俺の肉玩具!～
source:
The protagonist was forcibly appointed to do menial errands by the the student council.

Every day he was bossed around by the beautiful and tyrannical student council president, he was mocked by the treasurer and ignored by the secretary.

His youth was shrouded in darkness.

Then, one day, he unexpectedly acquired the power of hypnosis...

[Edited from the Amazon.co.jp product page of the DVDPG]
